Please do not include vulnerability details in this public issue.

Report vulnerabilities through GitHub Security Advisories for this repository. See [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for the supported versions, reporting process, and security model notes.

If GitHub Security Advisories are unavailable to you, submit only a minimal note here asking for a private security channel. Do not include exploit details, logs, tokens, secrets, proof-of-concept payloads, or affected private repositories.
